title: Interactive Experiments
description: A growing collection of small browser-native interaction, audio, and visual experiments.

experiments.title: Guitar Strings
experiments.description: A full-screen playable guitar-string toy with animated ripples, reactive background light, chords, and original riffs.

experiments.title: Piano Keys
experiments.description: A full-screen playable piano with animated keys, glowing note ripples, chords, and public-domain demo songs.

experiments.title: Lego Tetris Wall
experiments.description: A falling brick-piece wall builder where rows never disappear and each facade becomes a building.
